subject: Can you video the upcoming workshop on INLA

messages.author: ff1a5632abbf2fe9
messages.subject: Can you video the upcoming workshop on INLA
parts:
Hi, INLA experts

I am excited that The Third Workshop on Bayesian Inference for Latent Gaussian Models with Applications will take place, LGM2013: 12-14 Sept 2013, in Reykjavik, Iceland. However, I cannot take part in this interesting workshop, since I have some urgent matters in these days. I think this problem may apply to a lot of people who are interested in using INLA.

Could you video the whole workshop and then upload them to something like Youtube? if you don't mind.
I think this would greatly help us who are eager to master this method. I used to learn a lot about spatial model from the following web, https://geodacenter.asu.edu/eslides. It would be great if you can do the same thing.


Best,
Xing
